slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Must every unit of demand be fully satisfied (i.e., total delivered to each demand point j equals b_j exactly), or is it acceptable to leave some demand unmet if doing so lowers total cost?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each demand point must receive exactly b_j or whether unmet demand is allowed.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, where total cost equals the sum of the fixed costs for each used marshaling station plus the sum of all unit transportation costs multiplied by the corresponding shipment quantities?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included both fixed station costs and variable transportation costs.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; remaining unresolved integrality issue is not a listed P0/P1 hidden slot and was explicitly flagged as an assumption.

summary: The agent recovered both P0 hidden slots through direct questions and stopped appropriately after resolving the core modeling facts, though it repeatedly asked about integrality without resolution and then explicitly flagged that as an assumption.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
